review_scope: Pre-fix review of bc6694f8 and 0eedda92 only. This reviewer subsequently authored a D120 repair and cannot independently approve it.

verdict_a_acceptance.evidence: The guard reads documentElement scrollWidth/clientWidth and scrollLeft/left from live DOM geometry. It rejects the recorded 391/360 overflow and 31/-31 shift, requires the six result-tab labels and in-viewport rectangles, and accepts a two-row contained fixture. The previous source review of the wrapping fix is plausible; no post-fix native receipt proves the panel layout or reload lifecycle.

findings.finding: The new reload timeline is not retained on every failure. reload.click(), poll Target.getTargets, replacement-panel lookup and later management or attach failures can throw without lifecycleEvidence, so the Scrape receipt writes no reload_lifecycle_failure. The prior D120 failure class has a timeline, but the success-and-failure diagnostic contract remains incomplete.

The guard checks tab geometry and document displacement but does not assert measured title or capture-row visibility. The native click driver and screenshots still provide separate evidence for those controls.

positive_checks: The 0eedda92 acceptance predicate still requires old-worker destroyed event, old-worker and panel absence, a replacement worker, and its created event.

The timeline records ordered timestamps and owned target IDs/types; captureLifecycleEvidence allowlists these fields and removes arbitrary URL, title and content keys. The producer's service_worker/page values and Chrome-like target IDs fit the sanitizer's accepted shape.
Timeline entries are capped at 80 and target lists at 16; the final snapshot survives separately.

readiness: The important finding was routed for repair. This report is historical pre-fix evidence; a fresh zero-authorship reviewer must decide readiness on the repair commit. No native browser, build or release was run in this lane.
